Definition: from G4012 and G2989; to illuminate all around, i.e. invest with a halo:--shine round about.
BiblicalUsage: Perilampo means to shine round about, to invest with light. Paul saw a light from heaven above the brightness of the sun, shining round about him on the Damascus road, and the glory of the Lord shone round about the shepherds when the angel came.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the same light shines on a persecutor and on shepherds: it blinds one to his old way and it wakes the other to the good news.
